Phase A evidence — opt-in SMMUv3 topology, direct boot (observed Ame kernel log).

Reproduce:
  AME_QEMU_IOMMU=1 python3 scripts/test/boot.py --build out/verify --mode direct \
      --cpus 2 --marker "all services ready"

QEMU topology (opt-in):
  -machine virt,virtualization=on,gic-version=2,iommu=smmuv3,default-bus-bypass-iommu=off
  -device ramfb -device qemu-xhci,id=xhci -device usb-kbd,bus=xhci.0
  -device usb-mouse,bus=xhci.0 -device virtio-gpu-pci

Result: success, reason=ready. Serial excerpt (host UART, PL011):
